name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible at all times, so users never hunt for labels. The trade-off is screen space, but clarity beats compactness when users need to decode data fast.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data—labels overlap, forcing users to scroll or squint. A floating legend that collapses on hover would save space, but users might miss it entirely. The real test: measure how often users interact with the legend in both designs under real task loads.
